text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Tuesday, January 15, 2019 Posted by admin on January 15th, 2019
There are no Dow stocks at 52 week highs. There are no Dow stock 52 week lows.
The Market
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open down -32 points.
Monday the Dow was down -86.11 (-0.36%) at 23,909.84.
Year-to-date the Dow is up +2.50%.
There were 9 Dow stocks up Friday.
The Dow stock winners Friday were led by JPMorgan (JPM) +1.03%, Goldman Sachs (GS) +1.01% and United Technologies (UTX) +0.82%.
The Dow stock losers Friday were led by Merck (MRK) -2.04%, Apple (AAPL) -1.50% and Walgreens (WBA) -1.48%.
JPMorgan (JPM) misses the mark. See earnings below.
European stocks are mostly higher and Asian markets ended higher.
The national average price of gasoline is down two-tenths of a cent at $2.243 per gallon.
